data.name: Abdushakur
data.gender_notes: Abdushakur is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Abdushakur is derived from the Arabic words 'Abd' (servant) and 'Shakur' (generous, thankful). This name signifies a servant of the Almighty Allah, who is known for His boundless generosity and mercy towards His creation. The name Abdushakur carries the meaning “Servant of the Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abdushakur usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of the generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A constant reminder of Allah's generosity and mercy.
data.etymology: Abdushakur belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of the Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abdushakur total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
